Four rules for every performance check.

Throttle the CPU.

Record and click.

Find tasks over 50 milliseconds.

Split the work so the page paints first, then record again.

Then compare with the good values:

LCP 2.5 seconds, INP 200 milliseconds, CLS 0.1.
